item.title: Yesiang posts record revenue for third straight month on advanced process demand
item.summary: Yesiang Enterprise, a major maker of advanced-process microcontamination control filters, reported strong first-half 2026 results and said July consolidated revenue reached NT$305 million, a monthly record for the third straight month. The gains came as a global foundry leader continued expanding advanced-process capacity, boosting demand for high-end filtration products.
